name: homebridge-snapshot-sensors
description: Homebridge plugin that retrieves camera snapshots and runs on-device YOLO object detection

scripts.build: npm run clean && node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');const p=process.platform+'-'+process.arch;const dir=path.join('native','yolo-runner','bin',p);const bin=process.platform==='win32'?'snapshot-sensors-yolo.exe':'snapshot-sensors-yolo';const f=path.join(dir,bin);if(!fs.existsSync(f)||!fs.statSync(f).isFile())throw new Error('Prebuilt YOLO runner is missing: '+f);" && tsc
scripts.build:all: npm run clean && node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');const dir=path.join('native','yolo-runner','bin','linux-x64');for(const file of ['snapshot-sensors-yolo','libonnxruntime.so']){const p=path.join(dir,file);if(!fs.existsSync(p)||!fs.statSync(p).isFile())throw new Error('Required Linux x64 YOLO component is missing: '+p);}" && tsc
